i1.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
The iconic water fragrance, deepened and made refillable.

Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml is a floral aquatic fragrance for women, launched in 2025 and created by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie. A marine posidonia accord opens it with a fresh, watery glow, a heart of sunny ylang-ylang brings rich floral warmth, and it settles into a soft, enveloping vanilla. The bottle unscrews so it can be refilled from the dedicated refill.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Posidonia Accord
  • Heart: Ylang-Ylang
  • Base: Vanilla

Key details

  • Brand: Issey Miyake
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum Intense
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Aquatic
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh posidonia (sea grass) accord opening
  • A warm, sunny ylang-ylang heart
  • A soft, enveloping vanilla base
  • Refillable 100ml Eau de Parfum Intense

FAQ

What does L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense smell like?

Posidonia accord first, then ylang-ylang, finishing with vanilla.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.

i2.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau & Cèdre Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml
i2.descriptionHtml:
Water meets wood in a fresh, intense cedar.

Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau & Cèdre Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml is a woody fragrance for men, released in 2022 to mark 30 years of L'Eau d'Issey. Grapefruit, cardamom and cypress open it fresh and lightly spiced, a heart of cedarwood brings a clean, dry woodiness, and it settles into an earthy base of vetiver and patchouli.

  • Heart: Cedarwood
  • Base: Vetiver, Patchouli

Key details

  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette Intense
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Woody · Fresh · Aquatic
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh grapefruit, cardamom and cypress opening
  • A clean, dry cedarwood heart
  • An earthy vetiver and patchouli base
  • Handy 50ml Eau de Toilette Intense

FAQ

What does Eau & Cèdre smell like?

Grapefruit, cardamom and cypress first, then cedarwood, finishing with vetiver and patchouli.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

i3.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 75ml
i3.descriptionHtml:
The fresh, aquatic classic that defined a generation.

Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 75ml is a woody aquatic fragrance for men, created in 1994 by perfumer Jacques Cavallier as the brand's first men's scent. Yuzu, mandarin and verbena open it zesty and bright with aromatic coriander and sage, a heart of blue water lily, nutmeg, cinnamon and saffron adds a watery, gently spiced freshness, and it dries down to warm amber, tobacco, musk, sandalwood and vetiver.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Yuzu, Mandarin, Verbena, Cypress, Coriander, Sage
  • Heart: Blue Water Lily, Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Saffron, Geranium
  • Base: Amber, Tobacco, Musk, Sandalwood, Vetiver

Key details

  • Brand: Issey Miyake
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Woody · Citrus · Aquatic
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A zesty yuzu, mandarin and verbena opening
  • A watery, gently spiced water lily and nutmeg heart
  • A warm amber, sandalwood and vetiver base
  • A modern classic since 1994

FAQ

What does L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme smell like?

Yuzu, mandarin, verbena, cypress, coriander and sage first, then blue water lily, nutmeg, cinnamon, saffron and geranium, finishing with amber, tobacco, musk, sandalwood and vetiver.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

i6.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pure Pétale de Nectar Eau de Toilette 50ml

Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pure Pétale de Nectar Eau de Toilette 50ml is an aquatic floral fragrance for women, launched in 2019 as part of the L'Eau d'Issey Pure collection. Honey and juicy pear open it sweet and radiant, a heart of rose brings a soft, nectar-like bloom, and it settles into the Pure signature of sandalwood with an ambergris and cashmeran accord. It comes in a rose-gold bottle inspired by a drop of rose nectar.
